summary.name: Amethyst
summary.one_liner: Amethyst is a tiling window manager for macOS, modeled on xmonad, that arranges windows into automatic layouts controlled by keyboard shortcuts.
use_cases: Arranging windows automatically on a Mac without dragging
Navigating windows and spaces entirely from the keyboard
Splitting multiple windows into main and secondary panes
Throwing windows between spaces and screens with shortcuts
summary.what_it_does: Amethyst is a tiling window manager for macOS along the lines of xmonad. It offers multiple layouts, including Tall, Tall-Right, Wide, Two Pane, three-column variants, Widescreen-Tall, Fullscreen, Column, Row, Floating, and Binary Space Partitioning, and you cycle among them with keyboard shortcuts. Default shortcuts use option+shift (mod1) and ctrl+option+shift (mod2) combinations to resize panes, move focus, swap windows, and throw windows to other spaces or screens. Configuration is done via YAML in the home directory, and custom layouts can be written in JavaScript (beta). It is installable by direct download or with Homebrew cask.
notable: xmonad-style layouts with many tiling modes including BSP and columns
Keyboard-driven focus, swap, and throw commands with default shortcuts
Custom layouts via JavaScript (beta) and YAML configuration file
caveats: Needs Accessibility permission under Privacy & Security
Default Spaces auto-rearrange setting should be disabled for predictable space navigation
